Hi Events Team,

I’m Natalie, one of Jake Essex’s agents.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist based in Essex who delivers a high-energy, authentic “Elvis and Friends” show — taking audiences from raw 50s rockabilly through to 70s Vegas powerhouse, mixed with golden-era hits from Sinatra, Bobby Darin, Dion, Roy Orbison and more. He hits every note with real soul, uses quality backing tracks, and focuses on storytelling rather than gimmicks (no jumpsuit — just pure vocals and passion).

If you check his Instagram @JakeEssexMusic or Facebook (@itsjakeessex) you’ll see exactly what he does and hear his voice for yourself. He’s also recently been in talks with The Voice UK producers, but he will always honour every booking he receives.

Jake is already a regular at venues across Essex and consistently gets excellent feedback from both landlords and audiences. He’s fully professional, reliable, and flexible with set lengths (2 × 45 mins or 3 × 45 mins).

Key details for you:
• No deposit required
• Competitive prices
• Discount available for multiple bookings

Jake is looking to add a couple more regular dates in the local area and would love to perform at The Welcome Club Stanford-le-Hope.

Would you be open to a short chat or a quick demo video? I’m happy to send his latest showreel and availability straight away.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Natalie

subject: Jake Essex – Professional Solo Vocalist (Elvis & Friends Show) Available for Live Music Nights

messages.label: First pitch / sent
messages.subject: Jake Essex – Professional Solo Vocalist (Elvis & Friends Show) Available for Live Music Nights
messages.body:
Hi Team at The Gordon Arms,

I’m Natalie, booking agent for Jake Essex.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist based locally in South Ockendon who delivers a high-energy “Elvis and Friends” show — classic hits from the 50s, 60s & 70s.

I noticed you’re putting on live music, DJs and tribute acts — Jake would be a great fit and he’s keen to play venues like yours in the Chislehurst / SE9 area.

He’s fully self-contained (PA, lights, backing tracks), reliable, no deposit required, and used to busy pub crowds.

You can check out his recent performances here: https://www.instagram.com/jakeessexmusic/

Happy to discuss any upcoming dates you’re looking to fill, set times, and pricing.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Natalie
Booking Agent for Jake Essex
jakeessexenquiries@gmail.com
@JakeEssexMusic

messages.body:
Jake’s here this Sunday ????? So bit confused

Sent from Outlook for iOS

messages.label: Sent
messages.subject: Jake Essex – Professional Solo Vocalist (Elvis & Friends Show) Available for Live Music Nights
messages.body:
Hi Team at The Gordon Arms,

I hope this email finds you well.

I wanted to apologise sincerely for any confusion caused by my recent email regarding Jake Essex’s availability.

I have now spoken with Jake, and I understand that he is already booked to perform at The Gordon Arms this Sunday through his other agency, Choice Live. It is a sheer coincidence that my email was sent at the same time, and I should have double-checked his diary beforehand.

I work privately for Jake on his private bookings and events, and I send a large number of emails to multiple venues each week. Unfortunately on this occasion there was an overlap that caused confusion.

Please accept my apologies once again for any inconvenience this may have caused.

Best regards,

Natalie
